summary: The filing is a Form 6-K from Ecopetrol S.A. reporting the formalization of a bylaws amendment approved at its November 11, 2025 shareholders meeting. The amendment was registered with the Bogotá Chamber of Commerce via public deed. No transaction, tender offer, activist campaign, or special event is described; this is a routine corporate governance disclosure. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K serves as a report of a bylaw change. There are no deal terms, recommendations, or structural mechanics. The filing warrants no special-situations classification and is categorized as None.
